title: Solid Core vs. Foam Core PVC for DWV Systems
description: Understanding pipe material structure is essential for proper drainage system performance and code compliance. Solid core Schedule 40 PVC consists of dense, uniform plastic throughout its wall, offering high structural strength, superior impact resistance, and suitability for pressurized or underground applications where soil loads exist. Foam core PVC features a lightweight porous inner layer sandwiched between thin solid skins, reducing weight and cost for non-pressure interior DWV lines. Selecting the correct pipe depends on structural demand, noise control, and local code approvals.

Selecting the correct pipe depends on structural demand, noise control, and local code approvals.
